g.text: Payment link · Selling to someone without an account
Wants a link for a size
[The SKU doesn't exist or its product is deactivated]
200 PaymentLink, the same one as always
Creates the Payment Link with shipping address collection
Without the address, the webhook can't fill
the destination columns, which are NOT NULL:
the customer is charged and the order never gets recorded
Changing the price or hitting zero deactivates it; the replacement
is created lazily, and that 201 instead of 200 is how the manager
finds out the one they were handing out has stopped working
Pays and fills in their address
Creates or reuses the GUEST user by their email
Creates the paid order and decrements the stock
Queues the email with the order link
Free, not merely present: units held by a
pending checkout don't count. A payment through a
healthy link can still end up refunded because of this,
and it's the deliberate trade-off: refunding is reversible,
overselling to someone who already reserved is not.
Reading the order without an account
Opens the link from the email
scheme has no customer: the buyer's email
can't reach whoever holds the link
[The owner has since verified an account]
GUEST never signs in again, so
a link can't come back to life. The order moves
